messages:
maria: Quick FYI — opened PR #842 to add a Java SDK snippet in the auth guide. Docs preview failed with linkcheck + spellcheck. Can someone review and help with CI? https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842
preview-bot: preview failed for PR #842 — linkcheck: /guides/auth.md -> 'TokenManager' link returned 404. spellcheck: found 'credsential' (likely typo). Logs: 
```
LinkCheckError: /guides/auth.md: line 88: https://redwood.ai/docs/tokenmanager -> 404
Spellcheck: auth.md: line 112: 'credsential' not recognized
```
sam: I can pick this up in ~30m. Is it blocking the merge? @maria
maria: Not blocking the urgent release but would prefer to merge before the doc sweep. I tried updating the link to TokenManager but CI still flags the spellcheck for `credsential` inside a code example.
eli: Vale also reported a couple of stylistic issues but those shouldn't block. For spellcheck: our pipeline sometimes picks up inline code ticks. I will run the linter locally. Try `npm run docs:lint -- --pr 842`
sam: If it's just a typo, a one-line commit should fix it. Suggestion:
```diff
- `credsential`
+ `credential`
```
I can approve after green CI.
maria: pushed a small fix (force-pushed) commit 9f3b7f2 that corrects the inline typo and updated the TokenManager URL. Triggering preview again: /bot re-run preview
preview-bot: Re-run queued. New preview URL: https://deploy-preview-842--docs.redwood.ai/ (status: running)
preview-bot: Preview failed again: markdownlint MD034 — heading may not be surrounded by blank lines near line 45 in auth.md 
eli: That MD034 is my fault — I removed an extra blank line while reformatting examples. I'll open a tiny follow-up commit to re-add the blank line and leave a comment so the lint is clear. @sam can you re-review once CI is green?
sam: Yup. Also please add a one-line changelog note for the SDK snippet correction. :thumbsup:
maria: Thanks all — I'll wait for green CI then merge and tag. If anyone is blocked, I can open a separate PR for the changelog.
preview-bot: Preview succeeded. Status: success. Deployer URL: https://deploy-preview-842--docs.redwood.ai/
